newsitem.title: USA: TWA sets 3-day ticket sale on some routes.
newsitem.headline: TWA sets 3-day ticket sale on some routes.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc. said Tuesday it set special fares to Florida, Hawaii and San Juan, Puerto Rico.

Sample roundtrip fares include $650 between Chicago and Honolulu, compared with the existing fare of $748; Detroit and San Juan, $358, down from $460; St. Louis and Orlando, Fla., $198 versus $253, and Boston and San Juan, $228, down from $431.
Reservations must be made through Sept. 19 and tickets must be purchsed within 72 hours of making a confirmed reservation. Tickets also must be bought at least 14 days prior to departure.
Sale fares are valid for travel through Dec. 18. Holidays and some other blackout dates apply, TWA said.
A Saturday night stay is required and tickets are non-refundable.
